target_egfr.name: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor
target_egfr.description: Receptor tyrosine kinase involved in cell proliferation and survival signaling. Key oncology target in non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumors.

target_cox2.name: Cyclooxygenase-2
target_cox2.description: Inducible prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase involved in inflammation. Target for NSAIDs and selective COX-2 inhibitors.

target_braf.name: Serine/Threonine-Protein Kinase B-Raf
target_braf.description: MAP kinase pathway component. BRAF V600E mutation drives melanoma and other cancers. Target for vemurafenib and dabrafenib.

target_ace2.name: Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme 2
target_ace2.description: Carboxypeptidase that converts angiotensin II to angiotensin-(1-7). Key regulator of cardiovascular homeostasis.

target_5ht2a.name: 5-Hydroxytryptamine Receptor 2A
target_5ht2a.description: G protein-coupled serotonin receptor. Primary target for atypical antipsychotics and implicated in mood disorders.
